info.title: Solo API
info.description: REST API for bookkeeping, for one person: businesses, invoicing, expenses, mileage, allocations and reports. Money amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit (cents). Dates are ISO 8601. There is no sign-in: every request acts as the owner. Every state-changing request must send         `x-client-kind: web|desktop|mobile`, and the desktop app's local server also requires its `x-api-key`.

adjustment.description: GST to claim (positive) or pay back (negative), minor units; 0 when the change is too small.

business_use.description: Business use recorded for the period (None until reviewed).

ended.description: The period has ended, so it can be reviewed.

period_end.description: The balance date that ends the period.

previous_use.description: What it's compared with: the intended use, or the use at the last adjustment.

reviewable.description: The next period to review: earlier ones are all reviewed.

business_use.description: Business use in the period (0–100); null removes this review and the later ones.

first_name.description: Empty until the owner enters a name.

default_rate_id.description: Rate for new trips with this vehicle.

is_default.description: Make this the vehicle new trips start with. The first vehicle always is.

oneOf.description: Creates a rate and makes it the default (instead of `default_rate_id`).

fuel_type.description: petrol, diesel, hybrid, plug_in_hybrid, electric or other.

is_default.description: The vehicle new trips start with.

trip_count.description: Trips recorded with this vehicle (not deleted).

vehicle_type.description: car, van, ute, motorcycle, truck or other.
